title: Existing joint structures and residual integration controls
decision_reason: Retained sources support a bounded validation question; complete operational/financial records, accountable owner confirmation and applicable authority are absent.
current_arrangement: Eleven retained UN80 arrangement records describe existing, proposed or coordinated functions. Joint Gender Unit, regional structure and peacebuilding/support arrangements have differing documentary status and unverified operating/funding configurations.
testable_mechanism: For each named arrangement, reconcile approved and actual ownership, unique posts, funds, processes and products to distinguish already integrated controls, incomplete integration and genuinely substitutable residual work.
feasible_alternative_to_test: Retain a functioning joint control or document a specific missing integration step; consolidate only a separately resourced task shown unnecessary under the required operational and authority safeguards.
safeguards: Protect gender, disability, peacebuilding, military/police and field specialist functions
Respect departmental delegations, donor restrictions and separate governing mandates
Do not collapse coordinated functions into one assumed organization or duplicate existing joint controls
cost_perimeter_and_nonadditivity: SA04 is a combined 27,942.6-thousand OAMP/PBPS allocation and cannot be split without evidence. Include both departments and every fund, transferred and residual staff and transition/management costs. Existing reforms and C10 regional costs are baseline/nonadditive; eleven arrangements are not eleven benefit pools.
minimum_records: Arrangement-specific final approval/delegation, approved and actual organigram and start dates
Unique post/person/fund roster, cost centres and recurring/transition expenditure across departments
Joint workplans, management and clearance ownership, outputs, demand and actual workload
Existing process controls, donor constraints, service outcomes and independent implementation evidence
custodian_roles_to_confirm: DPPA and DPO leadership and each joint-arrangement owner
Departmental HR, budget and donor-fund custodians
Relevant mission/service users and independent operational reviewer

case_specific_limit: Budget narrative terms such as established, consolidated and coordinated remain attributed descriptions; they do not prove full operational merger or verified net benefit.
handling: No identifiable payroll, participant, medical, security, live transaction or restricted clearance records in this public dossier; use authorized restricted intake and approved safe derivatives.
reopen_condition: Confirm owner and authority, obtain authenticated complete linked records, define comparator and guardrails, and adjudicate validation-ready evidence. A prepared request or software pass is insufficient.
